svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: A waybar with one green lamp dot. A click on it opens the Roundhouse drawer out of the dot: a line saying Switchyard is building storefront, CPU and GPU tiles with temperatures against their limits, memory, pressure, network and memory by app, then the Storage tab with disks and a network share. The tab row ends with a link to the Switchyard board.
